documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited presented its Q4 and FY26 financial results, highlighting the transition from a trading-led model to a manufacturing-driven business with full commercial production commencing at its Vadodara facility. Annual revenue grew 37.7% year-on-year to INR 110.3 crores, while full-year PAT increased 73.6% to INR 12.2 crores. Plant capacity utilization reached approximately 60% during its first year of operations, with management aiming for 100% utilization by the end of FY27. Management highlighted that backward integration into in-house binder and glue production provides higher EBITDA margins compared to trading and is targeting a 50:50 revenue split between manufacturing and trading going forward. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for Q4 and FY26, highlighting strong revenue and profitability growth alongside its transition from trading to manufacturing.

guidance.claim: Silkflex expects to reach full capacity utilization at its plant by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates an overall company EBITDA margin expansion of 2% to 3% upon reaching full capacity utilization.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase the contribution of manufacturing to 50% of its total revenue mix in FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

guidance.claim: Management expects distribution revenue from the wood-coating segment to double from INR 6 crores to INR 12-14 crores.
guidance.quote: Plus, our distribution of business for wood-coating, the current contribution of 6%, the growth of that can also double. Meaning we can even take it from INR6 crores to INR12 crores, INR14 crores.

guidance.claim: Trading revenue is expected to grow by 10% to 20% while management prioritizes manufacturing growth.
guidance.quote: 10%-20% growth, but the focus will continue to be on manufacturing for this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects 15% to 20% growth in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% growth in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

guidance.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
guidance.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic customer response for wood coating products is strong due to growing demand for solvent-free solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: But now we are hoping for the domestic market as well as we are getting very good response from the customers.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated it is encouraged by improving demand trends in the wood coating segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain growth driven by domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Global apparel and lifestyle brands are expanding procurement in India as the China Plus One strategy gains momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: Trade agreements with the EU and US open growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports by eliminating duties.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

capex_expansion.claim: Silkflex commenced full-scale commercial production at its 10-acre automated Vadodara plant.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding new machinery funded through internal resources to expand its product portfolio.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Silkflex opened a branch in Kochi to target furniture manufacturers seeking solvent-free wood coating solutions.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, 3 months before, we have been opened a branch at Kochi which is a very good manufacturing hub for the furniture.

capex_expansion.claim: Adding vessels to utilize vacant plant space would require a capex of approximately INR 3 crore to INR 5 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a 72,000 sq. ft. state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Our company has successfully commenced production at its a 72,000 sq ft state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the company's first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility spans 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated plant designed to produce binders and glues.
capex_expansion.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: Silkflex added an office in Kochi during the quarter to support domestic wood coating products.
capex_expansion.quote: And in this quarter, we added the Kochi office for domestic wood coating products.

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing project funding included a bank loan of INR 30 crores, IPO funds of INR 10 crores for land, internal accruals, and promoter loans.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration into binder and glue manufacturing is expected to improve EBITDA margins by 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the manufacturing segment stand around 20%-25%, compared to 12%-15% for the trading business.
margins_costs.quote: When we compare specifically for, comparison with manufacturing and trading business, we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs saw a sharp increase during the year due to global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: A proactive inventory strategy helped secure raw materials at favorable blended costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: The transition to a manufacturing-led model is intended to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 33.2%.
In Q3 FY26, EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Commencement of manufacturing for two products has reduced reliance on imports by about 10% to 12%.
margins_costs.quote: But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q3 FY26 rose by 117.4% to INR 4.06 crores with PAT margin improving to 12.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax also showed strong growth, rising by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara facility has an installed production capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Plant capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% during its first year of operation.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: Approximately 80% of the space at the new plant facility currently remains vacant for future expansion.
orders_capacity.quote: The percentage of the facility is still 80% is remaining there and that depends on our R&D once it will be done, as well as the market growth will be there, we will be fulfilling that 80% space also.

orders_capacity.claim: The company offers a diverse portfolio of 128 textile printing inks and 70 wood coating polymer products.
orders_capacity.quote: Silkflex offers a diverse portfolio of 128 textile printing inks and 70 wood coating polymer products.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first two months of manufacturing operations, the plant utilized around 60% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: At full 500-ton capacity, the plant can generate turnover of around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q3 FY26, manufacturing accounted for 25% of revenue while trading contributed 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, out of this INR33 crores revenue in Q3, from the manufacturing we are getting 25% and rest of the 75% from the trading business.

capital_allocation.claim: Management does not expect working capital to constrain growth given strong internal cash flow generation.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are very confident working capital will not become a constraint at least in the near future.

capital_allocation.claim: With major capex completed, company focus is shifting to reducing debt via internal cash accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now, the maximum requirement of our capex we have done, you know the manufacturing unit is already working. So now focus is on reducing debt also for our company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company holds a bank term loan of INR 30 crores and working capital borrowings of INR 20 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Short-term borrowings carry an interest rate of 8.5%.
Expected payback period for the INR 40 crores manufacturing plant investment is between 4 to 5 years.
capital_allocation.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: Future working capital requirements will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: It of course internal accruals. As huge capex is not required. So there is no need to go for the huge capex.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in the US dollar exchange rate introduce currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global supply chain disruptions continue to cause raw material price fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global factors that are currently going on, based on that the price fluctuations that have come in raw material are coming, those are also coming upon global supply and the entire chain dynamics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Bangladesh textilers are facing power disruptions, political unrest, rising production costs, and stricter compliance requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve 100% capacity utilization at its manufacturing facility by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex targets increasing manufacturing to 50% of its revenue mix in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to focus on debt reduction funded through internal cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: So right now, the maximum requirement of our capex we have done, you know the manufacturing unit is already working. So now focus is on reducing debt also for our company.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reduce costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and internal efficiencies.
management_commitments.quote: Reducing costs through branch infrastructure sharing, solar energy adoption, and improved internal efficiencies in logistics, inventory, and processes.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex expects to achieve full plant capacity by the next financial year based on market demand.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects its revenue mix between trading and manufacturing to reach an equal 50% split within 1 to 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management has planned an expansion within the next 6 months to make domestic binders or inks.
management_commitments.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
